metadata.title: FAQ | Sanskriti Kindergarten
metadata.description: Quick answers to parent questions on programs, timings, meals, safety, routines, and communication.

hero.subtitle: Clear answers for families exploring Sanskriti Kindergarten.

image.alt: Children learning together in a bright kindergarten classroom

sidebar.description: Reach out for help with admissions, schedules, routines, or classroom guidance.

faqs.q: What age groups do you accept?
faqs.a: We accept children aged 2 to 6 years across age-appropriate programs: toddlers (2-3), pre-K (3-4), and kindergarten (4-6).

faqs.q: What are the school hours and daycare options?
faqs.a: School hours are typically 9:00 AM to 1:30 PM for pre-K and up to 3:00 PM for kindergarten. Extended daycare is available until 6:00 PM.
We maintain small groups for individual attention. Each class has a lead teacher and trained support staff.

faqs.q: What is your philosophy on education?
faqs.a: We follow a play-based, child-centered approach where children learn through exploration, creativity, and guided discovery.
Yes. Fresh vegetarian meals are prepared in-house, and we support allergy or dietary requirements where needed.

faqs.q: How do you handle safety and security?
faqs.a: The campus is CCTV monitored with gated entry. Staff are trained and follow clear child-safety practices.
Yes. Children wear a comfortable daily uniform and a separate sports uniform on activity days.

faqs.q: How do you handle potty training?
faqs.a: We work closely with parents and support children patiently as they build toilet independence.

faqs.q: How do parents stay updated about daily activities?
faqs.a: We share regular updates through daily highlights, weekly observations, and direct parent communication.

faqs.q: Do you focus only on academics?
faqs.a: No. We balance early literacy and numeracy with social, emotional, creative, and independent learning skills.
